visual_review.oak: Candidate has visibly fuller crown and fewer empty interiors than baseline. Leaf clusters still read as fine speckled/cutout masses and separated lobes, not demonstrated photorealistic vegetation. Bounded improvement acknowledged.
visual_review.palm: Fronds remain conspicuously thin, regular wire-like arcs with sparse leaflets; the color change does not resolve silhouette realism.
visual_review.car: Candidate has clearer separate side windows but rigid wedge-like body and abrupt planar transitions. Two conspicuous red rear-light blocks sit above or detached from the rear body surface; white front lamps protrude as oversized rectangular blocks. This is a visible regression despite valid indices and preserved placement.
visual_review.limits: Comparison-scale image supports these defects; no close-up material/performance or corridor integration acceptance inferred. Existing source assets and active scene remain unchanged.

observations: Candidate oak is fuller and casts a more continuous crown shadow; fine speckled/card clusters and separate crown lobes remain evident. This is a bounded improvement, not photorealistic species validation.
Palm still has very thin regularly spaced frond/leaflet arcs and bare-looking sparse canopy; realism issue persists under corrected units.
Candidate sedan now has better integrated lights/body than the earlier v3b image: conspicuous oversized white lamp blocks and raised red blocks are no longer visible in their earlier form.
Sedan remains generic and strongly angular, with abrupt hood/cabin/roof transitions and limited believable body curvature/detail. Comparison does not justify whole car realism acceptance.
corrected_v3c_visual_review.supersession: Latest v3c image supersedes earlier v3b light-block defect observation for this candidate revision; earlier revision evidence retained. Corrected axis/units do not erase the remaining visible asset-style limitations.
